name: page-header
purpose: The heading that opens a console page: an h1 whose `size` picks the heading token by page level, a one-line description, and the actions the page owns on the right. When the row runs out of room the actions move below the copy together; on a phone they stack, each at full width. Four optional regions complete a detail page's header without local markup: a `breadcrumbs` trail above the title, an `icon` before it, `meta` (a status tag, a version) beside it, and `tabs` across the bottom. It replaces the header markup every list, detail, settings and create page used to copy by hand.
useWhen: Use PageHeader once per console page for the h1, description and page actions; a band inside the page uses SectionHeader.
The top of any console page: a first-level list (`medium`), a detail tab or settings sub-page (`small`), a creation hub headline (`large`).
A page that owns actions (Documentation, a create action) that belong next to its title.
A resource detail page whose header carries the trail back to the list, the resource's icon, its status and the tabs of its sections (`breadcrumbs`, `icon`, `meta`, `tabs`).
avoidWhen: The heading of one band inside a page → use `section-header`.
A settings band with a Hint and a card of rows → use `settings-section`.
related: section-header` — the h2 band heading inside a page.
page-tabs` — the second-level navigation strip that sits above a detail page's header; a header-local tab row goes in the `tabs` slot.
breadcrumb` — the usual content of the `breadcrumbs` slot.
tag` — the usual content of the `meta` slot (a status, an environment, a version).
button` — the usual content of the `actions` slot (outlined, `size="medium"`).
bestPractices: One PageHeader per page; it renders the page's only h1.
Put the Documentation link first and the create action on the outer edge, both outlined at the medium size.
Do not set `class="w-full"` on the action buttons; the header makes them full width on a phone.
Set `titleId` when a form or landmark names itself with `aria-labelledby`.
breadcrumbs`: pass a `Breadcrumb` with `items`; its last entry is the current page and should match the title.
icon`: one decorative glyph or a square `Avatar`, at most 32 px; it is `aria-hidden` by default, since the title already names the page.
meta`: one or two small `Tag`s (status, environment). Longer facts (owner, created date) belong in the page body, not the header.
tabs`: a `Tabs` row of the page's sections. A page that already shows `PageTabs` above the header leaves this slot empty; never both.

props.name: title
props.doc: The page title, rendered as the page h1.

props.name: description
props.doc: One sentence under the title that says what the page is for.

props.name: titleId
props.doc: Id set on the h1, so a landmark or form can name itself with aria-labelledby.

slots.name: description
slots.notes: Rich description content (links, inline buttons); replaces the `description` prop.

slots.name: actions
slots.notes: The actions the page owns, Documentation first and the create action on the outer edge.

slots.name: breadcrumbs
slots.notes: The trail back to the parent pages, above the title row; usually a `Breadcrumb` with `items`.

slots.name: icon
slots.notes: A leading glyph or square avatar before the title, decorative (`aria-hidden`).

slots.name: meta
slots.notes: Short facts beside the title, such as a status `Tag`; wraps under the title when the row is narrow.

slots.name: tabs
slots.notes: The tabs of the page's sections, across the full width under the title and actions.

examples.name: ListPage
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import Button from '@aziontech/webkit/button'
  import PageHeader from '@aziontech/webkit/page-header'
</script>

<template>
  <PageHeader
    title="Resources"
    description="View and manage your resources."
  >
    <template #actions>
      <Button
        label="Documentation"
        icon="ai ai-book"
        variant="outline"
        size="medium"
        href="https://example.com/docs/resources"
        target="_blank"
      />
      <Button
        label="Create Resource"
        icon="ai ai-plus"
        variant="outline"
        size="medium"
      />
    </template>
  </PageHeader>
</template>
